sloka: विधि हीनस्य यज्ञस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति ।तद्यथा विधि पूर्वम् मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते ॥१-८-१८॥
transliteration: vidhi hīnasya yajñasya sadyaḥ kartā vinaśyati ।tadyathā vidhi pūrvam me kratureṣa samāpyate ॥1-8-18॥

translations.english: Therefore let the arrangements be made in a manner this sacifice is completed in accordance with the scriptures. And in this, you are experts".
